item.title: Samsung’s new camera sensor could make motion blur issues a thing of the past

item.title: Pixelated 081: Gemin-eyes
item.description: Welcome to episode 81 of Pixelated, a podcast by 9to5Google. This week, Abner shares his experience with trying out some early samples of glasses running on Google’s Android XR platform with Will and Damien. After a surprisingly impressive demo, is it time to start getting excited for the return of Google Glass-esque technology? The trio also dips into some new changes coming to Wear OS and take a quick look at the first One UI 8.5 beta, if only to ask: what’s up with the iOS-ification of Androi

item.title: Google Weather for Wear OS breaks on original Pixel Watch, Galaxy Watch
item.description: Back in September, Google stopped offering its Weather app for new Wear OS 6 devices. Google Weather has now stopped working on the original Pixel Watch and other devices due to a bug. more…

item.title: Stackable Play Points promo takes another $200 off Pixel 10 Pro or 10 Pro XL
item.description: Similar to YouTube TV, Google is offering some Play Points members a $200 discount on the Pixel 10 Pro or 10 Pro XL that can be used in conjunction with the current Google Store holiday offers. more…

item.title: The Philips Hue Wall Washer is a versatile but pricey way to fill a room with color
item.description: Smart home lighting has become pretty predictable over the years, but Philips Hue has a pretty clever idea in its new Wall Washer light. After using it for a few months, I’m pretty impressed by it, but it doesn’t exactly buck the stereotype for Hue’s pricing. more…
